title: Hollowbrook's verse-progress text repeatedly re-lists verse locations already obtained as still outstanding. After the ring-ditch verse it said 'Two more wait: the ring-ditch, the king's causeway, the mere-stone' (ring-ditch already done); after the causeway verse it said 'The last waits at the ring-ditch, the causeway, or the mere-stone' (both already done, only mere-stone left). The Vale's equivalent verse tracker narrows correctly ('Two more: the sunken shrine...and the barrow's hall' then 'One verse left: the barrow's own hall'), so this is an inconsistency between the two hold implementations.
where: The Ring-Ditch / The King's Causeway (Hollowbrook) — 'Three Old Verses' quest text
